name: Game Gary
tagline: Maps your gaming taste so recommendations reach the credits
description: It keeps a record of what hooks you and what loses you across mechanics, story and pacing, then uses that map to recommend games worth the money. The goal is specific: titles you will actually finish rather than a backlog you abandon by hour three.
author: FrankFindsOut
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
